DIAGNOSIS READY: Spontaneous Dissection of the Abdominal Aorta secondary to Valsalva maneuver during micturition.

The fainting immediately after urination without cardiac or metabolic causes is a classic presentation for an aortic dissection caused by a sudden increase in intra-abdominal pressure. This condition requires immediate surgical intervention to prevent rupture.
